text.description_html:
Sleek ADA Compliant Track Arm Closer

PDQ 5101-999025 track arm door closers are non-handed, and and can be mounted on the Push or Pull side of the door. ADA Compliant offering adjustable spring power sizes 1 - 6 for use on interior doors requiring less than 5 lbs. of opening force and exterior doors requiring less than 8.5 lbs.

The PDQ 5100 Series features full rack and pinion construction, heavy duty cast aluminum closer body, stamped flat style arm assembly and full architectural cover. Hydraulic control is achieved through separate hex-key non-critical sweep, latch and backcheck adjustments.

Package complete with fasteners for wood or metal doors and frames. Sex nuts and bolts are also furnished standard.

Hold open clip is included: Optional to install in the closer track. Holds the door in the open position when door fully opened.

The 5100 series closer is listed by U.L./U.L.C. (UL US Listed 63Z0), complies with UL 10C and UBC 7-2 (1997) for positive pressure and conforms to the requirements of ANSI A156.4 Grade 1.

Also available: A full line of PDQ 5100 Door Closer Accessories.

Specifications and Features for the PDQ 5101-999025 Track Arm Door Closer:

  • Adjustable Closing Speed
  • Adjustable Latching Speed
  • Adjustable Back Check
  • Cast Aluminum Alloy Shell
  • Closer Body Length: 11-7/8"
  • Track Length: 19"
  • Horizontal Mounting Holes: 11-1/8"
  • Vertical Mounting Holes: 3/4"
  • Maximum Door Weight: 258 lbs
  • Maximum Door Size: 58" interior / 54" exterior
  • Non-Handed
  • Grade 1 (Highest Grade)
  • Spring Size: Adjustable 1-6
  • ADA Compliant
  • 25 Year Warranty
  • 5101-BCPA Dimensions (PDF)
  • PDQ 5101 Track Arm Installation Instructions (PDF)
  • PDQ 5101 Installation Instructions (PDF)

Available in Aluminum or Dark Bronze finish.
